以参考图为起始画面，固定机位。主体从右侧边缘逐渐分解为细小金色粒子，粒子缓慢向右: Use the reference image as the opening frame with a locked camera. Gradually dissolve the subject from its right edge into fine golden particles drifting slowly right. Preserve the original shape, material and color of intact areas. Keep the background and lighting continuous. Smooth action in one unbroken shot; no text.
以参考图为起始画面，固定机位。主体由上至下缓慢软化并融化，保留原有颜色和材质光泽: Use the reference image as the opening frame with a locked camera. Slowly soften and melt the subject from top to bottom, preserving its color and surface sheen. Liquid flows down naturally and pools at the base. Keep the background unchanged, with consistent gravity, no cuts and no added objects.
以参考图为起始画面。细小花蕾沿主体表面逐渐生长，依次绽放成柔和的花朵。保留主体的: Start from the reference image. Tiny buds gradually grow across the subject and open into soft flowers. Preserve its overall silhouette and identifying details. Locked camera and background, soft natural light, gentle continuous motion, no cuts.
将参考主体作为巨型物体置于城市街区，保持主体外形、颜色和材质。周围楼宇与微小行人: Place the reference subject as a giant object in a city block, preserving its shape, color and material. Buildings and tiny pedestrians establish scale. Use a low, wide-angle camera tilting slowly up. Match contact shadows and scene lighting. Keep the subject stable without deformation in one continuous shot.
以参考图主体为中心，主体保持当前姿态不动。相机以稳定速度向右做小幅环绕，背景产生: Center the reference subject and freeze it in its current pose. Move the camera slowly and steadily in a small orbit to the right, with natural background parallax. Preserve subject identity, shape, materials and lighting. No extra limbs or objects. One continuous shot without cuts.
以参考图为起始画面，从主体近景开始，相机沿视线方向平滑快速后退，逐步揭示更宽阔的: Start from the reference image in a close-up and pull the camera smoothly and quickly backward along the viewing direction to reveal the surroundings. Keep the subject centered with stable shape and proportions. Continuous perspective and eased acceleration; no cuts or sudden scene changes.
